reversing_premises: That the task or the report defined the scientific target as the complete 96-station scheduled network rather than the screen-conditional subset
That the selected-result line asserted the 18/72 value for the scheduled network or for all planned units without the conditioning phrase
That the 24 outside-eligible stations were in fact assessed for occurrence and belonged to the declared target population
falsification_attempt.strongest_innocent_explanation: The strongest case for an in-scope issue would be that the report foregrounds a 96-station scheduled network and 'planned-unit accounting', so a reader could take the 25% figure as a network-level rate computed on only the 72 retained stations. That reading fails because both the task and the report's target population define the domain as the 72 signal-eligible stations, and the selected-result sentence itself carries the explicit conditioning phrase 'Among signal-eligible stations', so the claimed domain and the computed domain are the same retained set by design rather than by substitution.
